latestVersion.changelog:
VN Video Editor for PC — Initial Release

- Launch of cloud-based AI video editor for PC: upload raw clips, describe your edits, and export polished 1080p videos in minutes.
- No timeline or export settings needed; simply type your instructions for edits like trimming, transitions, BGM sync, and more.
- Seamless authentication: uses NEMO_TOKEN if set, or fetches a free anonymous token for new users.
- Supports popular video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB; simple workflows for quick edits, batching, and iterative refinement.
- Automatic session management, clear user prompts, and built-in handling for common errors (credits, token expiry, file limits).
- Exports high-quality MP4 videos via cloud GPU rendering, typically processing jobs in 30–90 seconds.
